title: Klikety Theme
description: Theme file for the Klikety overlay grid appearance. Supports JSON with Comments (JSONC).

labelFontFamily.description: Font family for grid cell labels.

labelFontSize.description: Font size for grid cell labels in points.

labelColor.description: Label text color as hex (#RRGGBB or #AARRGGBB).

cellBorderColor.description: Border color of grid cells as hex.

cellBorderThickness.description: Border thickness of grid cells in pixels.

cellBackgroundColor.description: Background color of normal grid cells as hex.

cellBackgroundOpacity.description: Opacity of normal cell background (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = opaque).

dimmedOverlayColor.description: Overlay color applied to non-matching cells after first key press.

dimmedOverlayOpacity.description: Opacity of dimmed cell overlay (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = opaque).

highlightedColumnBackground.description: Background color of the highlighted column after first key press.

highlightedColumnBorderColor.description: Border color of the highlighted column.

subgridBorderColor.description: Distinct border color for subgrid (level 2/3) cells.

subgridLabelColor.description: Distinct label color for subgrid (level 2/3) cells.

externalColLabelColor.description: Label color for external column labels when cells are too small for inline labels.

externalRowLabelColor.description: Label color for external row labels. Distinct from column labels for axis differentiation.

connectorLineColor.description: Color of connector lines linking external labels to their grid column/row.

connectorLineThickness.description: Thickness of connector lines in pixels.

labelOutlineColor.description: Stroke color for label text outlines as hex. Ensures readability over any background.

labelOutlineThickness.description: Stroke thickness for label text outlines in pixels.

smallCellBackgroundColor.description: Background tint color for LogGrid cells below the external-label threshold.

smallCellBackgroundOpacity.description: Opacity of the small-cell background tint (0.0 = transparent, 1.0 = opaque).

statusTextFillColor.description: Fill color for status text (e.g. drag target selection banner).

statusTextBackgroundColor.description: Background color for status text banner.

appScopeBorderColor.description: Border color for the app-scope visual indicator (2px border when overlay is scoped to a window).
